newsitem.title: USA: United Tech backs $4.00 eps '97 estimate.
newsitem.headline: United Tech backs $4.00 eps '97 estimate.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said Wednesday that it is comfortable with the First Call analysts' consensus earnings per share estimate of $4.00 for 1997, or 16 percent growth over $3.45 a share earned a year ago.

"We are comfortable with the consensus analysts' earnings per share estimate of $4.00 which is on First Call," said Martin Moore, spokesman for the maker of industrial products that range from plane engines to air conditioners.
Moore said the company expects United's earnings to be boosted by improvement in its aerospace business.
Moore said, however, that United expects little improvement in its automotive unit results from a year ago. The unit posted a decline in operating profit for the 1997 first quarter.
Earlier, the company reported 1997 first quarter earnings per share of $0.86 on revenues of $5.93 billion versus $0.62 a share on revenues of $5.39 billion a year before.
Moore also said profit gains at United's air conditioner unit, Carrier, and at Otis, its elevator unit, will drive 1997 earnings.

United's Carrier and Otis units posted 27 percent and 12 percent operating profit growth, respectively, in its first quarter. Its Pratt & Whitney unit, a maker of military and commercial aircraft engines, posted first quarter operating profit growth of 30 percent.
-- Harry Milling, New York Corporate Newsdesk, 212-859-1700
